transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Reflection AI launches Beam, a 501B MoE model with 23B active parameters, scoring 80.9 on SWE-bench. Confirmed by MarkTechPost.
Anthropic trains 10,000 artificial intelligence engineers by 2027 to deploy artificial intelligence in organisations. Reported by Digital Watch Observatory.
New Mexico Democrats accuse Republicans of violating an artificial intelligence campaign law with unmarked artificial intelligence images. Confirmed by News From The States.
Sam Altman argues artificial intelligence progress should outweigh risks, calling for liability if models cause harm during training. Still open, per Futurism.
Nvidia partners with six Wall Street firms for 500 billion dollars in artificial intelligence financing, offering 25 percent backstop on GPU-backed loans. Reported by Crypto Briefing.
Free every hour.
